name: Multi-cluster AI inventory controller
tagline: Kubernetes-native controller that inventories AI infrastructure across clusters, inspired by agentregistry.
problem: Enterprises lose track of which agents, MCP servers and AI resources run across many clusters.
solution: A multi-cluster inventory controller modelled on agentregistry concepts.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Strong thinking about scalable AI infrastructure management.
Author is a long-time contributor to the organizer's kagent project — deep familiarity with maintainers' priorities.

lessons: In open-source hackathons, prior contribution history is an advantage; newcomers should target the Starter track or contribute early.

curator_notes: Stack entry controller-runtime is an assumption from 'Kubernetes-native controller'; verify from repo.
